title: MysticNetworks
description: MysticNetworks is your favorite MC server revamped. I've ran MysticNetworks for years with a dedicated community and now we're bringing it back better than ever! NO PAY TO WIN, NON OP, VANILLA STYLE, DONUTSMP FEEL, WITH A FRESH START! Just reopened JUNE 19
body:
MysticNetworks is your favorite MC server revamped. I've ran MysticNetworks for years with a dedicated community and now we're bringing it back better than ever! NO PAY TO WIN, NON OP, VANILLA STYLE, DONUTSMP FEEL, WITH A FRESH START!

Just reopened JUNE 19th!

The best part about MysticNetworks is that the VOTERS get the best perks, including even being able to get DONOR RANKS for free!Progressive skilling, Free bookbag, Creative world, AND A LOT MORE!

COMPLETELY Built from the scratch, no downloaded worlds, or builds!

Skills
Not your typical skills plugin, full GUI based, super clean messaging, easy to understand!

BookBags
Every player gets 3-6 Bookbag rows, like a shulker! BUT be careful because when you die your backpack items still drop!

Bank
Want to drop off that loot from your raid? Head to spawn and there's a bank where you can access your Vault!

You can also deposit/withdraw Money and EXP with you custom bank GUI system too!

Heads
When you get killed by another player you drop your head, which is worth half your money!

Spawners
Every player can silk spawners, and the spawner items are Virtual to reduce lag, and easy automation!

Crates
Each player gets the same chances with keys, which are got from VOTING! This is the only way to get 6 Backpack Rows!

+ You can get FREE DONOR RANKS from the crates too!


Plotworld 
A Creative world with plots to use your imaginations!

Balanced economy, KitPVP, Proximity Voicechat, AND A LOT MORE!
